epilogue_centerpiece_note: Phelps et al. 2000 (NEURO-001) is the load-bearing experimental object of the Epilogue. Internal pages 729, 730, 733, 734, 736 are explicitly mobilized at book pp.137-140. The Phelps amygdala/race fMRI study is reframed by Gross + Preston as a situational-rhetorical object whose interpretation requires the kind of situated-emotion framework that Wilson-Mendenhall et al. 2011 (NEURO-002) provides on the humanities-friendly side of the same neuroscience field.
